Title: Blood Doll and The Rack clarity.

Messages.Author: dabbler
Messages.Body: Can a vamp work a blood doll in torpor? Does a vamp gain from the rack in torpor?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The answer is: cardtext!
If the card indicates "ready vampire", then it doesn't work. Otherwise, it works with vampires in torpor (= that are not ready).

(That's why it's important to include cardtext in your question).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
As LSJ would say: "cardtext".

Name: Blood Doll
Cardtype: Master
Master.
Put this card on a vampire you control. During his or her master phase, this vampire's controller may move 1 blood from this vampire to his or her pool or from his or her pool to this vampire.

Name: The Rack
Cardtype: Master
Master: unique location.
When this card is played or the controller of this card changes, the controller chooses a ready vampire he or she controls. During the controller's untap phase, the chosen vampire gains 2 blood. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can steal this location for his or her controller as a  action.

More explicitely: a Blood Doll can be used to move blood from/to a vampire in torpor. The Rack will give blood to a vampire in torpor.
